subject.title: All LLM API calls time out simultaneously despite APIs being reachable (multi-agent concurrency issue)

question: Should the remaining #43374 work change Telegram runner concurrency, global agent lane limits, provider transport timeout/DNS behavior, or only require fresh live proof before any further code change?
rationale: The source still shows shared Telegram/global agent concurrency, while related PRs fixed narrower timeout cascades; selecting the permanent boundary affects channel behavior, provider routing, and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but require a current-main four-agent Telegram/provider reproduction before approving further runtime or config changes.

options.title: Design Channel-Specific Concurrency
options.body: Approve a product change that lets Telegram/channel intake avoid the global agent concurrency bottleneck with explicit ordering and upgrade tests.

options.title: Close As Covered By Timeout Fixes
options.body: Close the issue as sufficiently mitigated by #80449, #87085, and #62682 despite no direct current-main Telegram multi-agent proof.

recommendation.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but require a current-main four-agent Telegram/provider reproduction before approving further runtime or config changes.
